title: Man Infraconstruction Ltd - 533169 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Man Infra FY26 consolidated PAT after minority interest of INR201 crores; FY27 launches targeted at INR5,500 crores GDV and sales ambition of over INR5,000 crores across FY27-FY28.
summary.overview: FY26 was described as a consolidation year: sales of about INR1,800 crores, collections of about INR990 crores and over 5 lakh sq ft sold, with consolidated revenue from operations of about INR630 crores. Q4 FY26 sales were about INR438 crores and collections about INR279 crores, with consolidated PAT after minority interest of INR43 crores on total income of INR187 crores. Management guided to a 35-40% rise in revenue recognition in FY27, driven by about 1 million sq ft of launches and near-complete projects, and reiterated a Vision 2030 goal of doubling GDV to over INR35,000 crores. Balance sheet was reported as net debt-free with net worth of about INR2,266 crores and liquidity of about INR686 crores against debt of about INR58 crores.

segments.name: Real estate (Mumbai)
segments.commentary: GDV portfolio above INR17,500 crores with balance sales pipeline of INR13,300 crores; management says about INR4,000 crores of the GDV is already sold and the rest is unsold. New Tardeo project adds about INR2,000 crores GDV and about 3 lakh sq ft saleable carpet; South Mumbai GDV above INR8,000 crores.

segments.name: Real estate (US, MICL Global)
segments.commentary: Estimated aggregate GDV of about US$1.4 billion across ongoing and one completed development in Florida. Minority stake acquired in West Avenue, Miami Beach project with estimated GDV above US$1 billion and over 100 units.

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Current EPC order book about INR392 crores to be executed over 3-4 years. Upcoming developments have about 1 crore sq ft construction area, of which about 50% expected to add to the EPC order book once FY27 launches occur. Port segment de-emphasised; management says it will bid selectively.

segments.name: Interest income on project investments
segments.commentary: Cumulative MICL Group investment across project entities about INR1,461 crores; management presents the interest income earned as a business income contributing to 'other income'.

guidance_outlook: FY27 launch pipeline of about INR5,500 crores GDV (about 1 million sq ft), including Marine Lines, Tardeo, BKC and Pali Hill; launches to be timed around Diwali for Marine Lines and Nov-Dec for Tardeo 2.0.
Combined sales ambition of over INR5,000 crores across FY27 and FY28; management targets not less than INR2,500 crores in FY27 with a roughly 50-50 split.
Revenue recognition expected to grow about 35-40% in FY27 versus FY26, with Ghatkopar, Dahisar and Atmosphere projects nearing completion.
Over 1 million sq ft carpet area to be delivered over the next 6-18 months; Aaradhya One Park targeted for completion by March 2027; Atmosphere Tower G expected within 18 months.
Vision 2030 goal to double development portfolio to over INR35,000 crores GDV, with management aiming to achieve it before 2031.
Management expects FY25 revenue and profit levels to be surpassed over time; no price appreciation assumed in project feasibility.
capex_capacity: Aaradhya Parkwood (Dahisar): first two towers of 35 storeys to be delivered within the next 6-18 months; project of over 1,000 units across four towers is about 90% sold.
Aaradhya Avaan (South Mumbai): 38-storey members tower delivered in under 2.5 years; final top floors launched and an in-building experience centre opened.
Aaradhya One Park (Ghatkopar East): 11 towers on about 3.2 acres, targeted completion by March 2027.
Atmosphere O2 Mulund Tower G: 47 storeys, about 70% sold, expected completion over the next 18 months.
Marine Lines: land fully vacated, rehab and sale tower construction started with IOD and CC received.
Tardeo 2.0 stand-alone project acquired; permissions applied for and launch targeted for Nov-Dec.
demand_pricing: Management says it has not assumed price appreciation in feasibility and does not expect a meaningful price rise in Mumbai; it expects volume absorption to hold.
Sales momentum cited: Ghatkopar more than 50% sold, Jade Park (Vile Parle) 50%+ sold, Tardeo above 65% sold, Artek Park (BKC) more than 20% sold within about 3 months of launch.
Aaradhya Avaan experience centre recorded over 200 visitors, with a strong weekly run-rate.
Management says it is pushing ticket sizes into the INR100-200 crore range is avoided, and that larger 3-BHK units (up to about 1,500 sq ft) are selling first.
Management sees consumers 'rethinking' purchases amid the geopolitical situation and is delaying the Marine Lines launch for better sentiment.
New MS Collection Residences brand launched for ultra-luxury boutique sea-view projects, separate from the Aaradhya community-building brand.

qa_highlights.question: Project-wise reconciliation of bookings, collections, completion % and revenue recognised against INR630 crore revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined on the call and said details would be shared post-call with the investor relations team.

qa_highlights.question: Risk of inventory overhang from ultra-luxury launches in South Mumbai over 3-5 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said MICL is not building INR100-200 crore tickets and its ticket sizes are comfortable for the micro-markets, so sales velocity risk is low.

qa_highlights.question: FY27 presales target versus the INR5,000 crore FY27-28 ambition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited INR5,500 crore of launch pipeline for FY27 and a target of at least INR2,500 crore, with a 50-50 split across the two years and no new projects assumed.

qa_highlights.question: Unsold versus already-sold inventory in the INR17,000 crore GDV, and revenue trajectory for FY27-29?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about INR4,000 crore of GDV is sold and the rest unsold; FY27 revenue recognition is expected to grow 35-40%, with no separate FY28-29 numbers given.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins be higher in ultra-luxury projects with lower asset turns?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said better margins are the intention in ultra-luxury projects and will show in coming years.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company double GDV, and how will it be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is in talks with more than 10 housing societies, with a mix of JDA, JV and redevelopment and a planned commercial portfolio; funding comes from ongoing project cash flows and surplus from future launches, with no annual spend figure given.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company moving away from EPC and ports?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ports remain an option when good opportunities arise, but real estate is the main focus; EPC work from its own 1 crore sq ft pipeline or partner projects will continue.

risks_watch: Revenue recognition is back-ended and depends on OC timing and launch execution; the company did not provide a project-wise reconciliation of bookings, collections and revenue.
Launch timing risk: Marine Lines and Tardeo 2.0 are pushed to Diwali and Nov-Dec, and management cited geopolitical and macro sentiment as a reason for waiting.
Revenue depends on the INR5,500 crore launch pipeline and the INR2,500 crore FY27 sales target, which are not yet approved in all cases.
Concentration in ultra-luxury, larger-ticket South Mumbai projects with longer timelines could increase revenue and earnings volatility.
Other income includes interest on about INR1,461 crore of project-entity investments and is presented as business income; the split between operating and non-operating income was not disclosed.
Business development targets (doubling GDV to INR35,000 crore) depend on winning 10+ society redevelopments currently in negotiation.
US exposure through MICL Global (about US$1.4 billion GDV) was not detailed on earnings or capital deployed.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on launches, sales momentum and the long-term GDV target, but evasive on detailed data: revenue reconciliation, segment split and annual price assumptions were all deferred to post-call follow-up. Caution appears on timing, with launches delayed to festive and Q3 windows due to macro sentiment.
key_quotes: And we target nothing less than INR2,500 crores for this upcoming year.
We are not making any exceptionally large apartments, which we feel can become a bottleneck for the company to sell and which can have a hindrance on the cash flow in the near future.
So we don't want the company's growth to depend just on the ports.
